purpose: GuildStock logo prototypes; not installed in the addon.

prototypes.name: 01-guild-vault
prototypes.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original square logo icon prototype for GuildStock, a World of Warcraft Forever addon for guildmates to find and share crafting materials. Hand-painted fantasy game UI icon with bold simplified shapes, warm antique gold, rich brown and restrained luminous accents to fit a dark bronze interface. Centered strong silhouette, reads clearly at 32px, generous transparent margin, polished stylized material rendering, no tiny decoration. No lettering, no words, no watermark, no scene or mockup. Actual transparent background. Subject: an open compact oak guild supply chest, thick brass bands, holding a clearly readable silver ingot, rolled red cloth and green herb sprig. A welcoming shared treasury, three-quarter view, low visual complexity.
